summary: Serves as the core entry point for the command-line interface application, defining the main Typer app instance and registering CLI commands such as greetings, Google routing configuration, AI settings, and code snapshots.
responsibilities: Provides the primary entry point and command-line interface application for executing commands such as greeting, Google routing registration, and code snapshots.
relationships: The main application initializes and registers commands including user greeting, Google routing configuration with AI settings, and code snapshot execution.
design_decisions: Uses Typer framework to build and organize command-line interface commands and options.
